readings: Which are the top 10 members by share of total event attendance? Match attendance to members by member id, count attendance per member id and position, and show the member id, position, attendance count and share of all attendance, from highest share to lowest.
queries:
SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.position,
    COUNT(*) AS attendance_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS attendance_share
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
ORDER BY attendance_share DESC
LIMIT 10
